title: AlignDB: a computational protocol for analyzing the relationship between indels and SNPs in genome sequences
protocol: Install all AlignDB requirement software and dependent Perl modules.
Read the README file in the AlignDB package root directory.
Install AlignDB itself.
Follow the steps in doc/tutorial.pdf for installation.
Use the example data in data/ directory for a trial run.
Prepare a set of input data in Blastz .axt file format.
Start the GUI shell by entering the base directory where AlignDB is installed and typing perl gui\gui2.pl.
Do not close the command line window.
Test your server by clicking on the "DB Server" notebook tab and checking MySQL server settings.
Initiate your database by clicking the "Init. alignDB" button to build the skeleton of the database.
Generate a two-way analysis database by clicking the "Gene. alignDB" button to analyze alignments and build the database.
Update features using Ensembl annotations by clicking the "Feature" tab and then the "Upd. feature" button.
Click the "Misc" tab.
Click "Upd. slippage" to run init\update_indel_slippage.pl.
Click "Upd. isw" to run init\update_isw_indel_id.pl.
Click the "Common stat" button.
An Excel workbook with 25 worksheets will be generated.
If running AlignDB on Windows, click the "Common chart" button.
This runs stat\common_chart_factory.pl that calls Excel to draw charts in .xls files by OLE.
Build another two-way comparison.
Load two completed databases into "first db" and "second db".
Generate "goal db" name with the default naming rule.
Leave the "T/Q/R:" options unchanged.
Click the "Ref outgroup" button.
Update two-way features in the comparison database.
Go to the "Misc" tab in the "Three-way" pane and click the "Upd. CpG" button to run extra/update_snp_cpg.pl.
Do statistics and get results by clicking the "Three stat" button, which runs stat/three_stat_factory.pl.
Chart the data by clicking the "Three chart" button, which runs stat/three_chart_factory.pl.
